verdict.rationale: Cloudflare states that registration, transfer, and renewal prices are shown upfront with no hidden fees or required add-ons. Domains are sold at cost with no markup and renew only at the registry's list price, which rules out a teaser first-year price followed by a renewal spike. Community posts quote specific per-TLD prices (e.g., .io, .space), showing prices are visible, though some TLDs cost more than at rivals. Missing for 10: an explicitly evidenced public per-TLD price list page covering all 400+ TLDs, independent confirmation that renewal matches first-year pricing.
